$comment: The colour-role contract for @gjuoun/bigface-business-ui. A theme file (src/themes/<id>.css, generated by scripts/gen-tokens.ts from src/themes/roles.ts) sets ONLY these variables, in ONE block: light-dark(light, dark) where the two palettes differ, one bare hex where they agree. Colour only: every size, radius, shadow geometry, font and motion value is Tailwind or shadcn own. scripts/theme-check.ts enforces it.

required.--theme-panel: Card, popover, secondary, muted, accent and sidebar fill. Palette panel.
required.--theme-fg: Body and heading ink, and the ink on frame/solid. Palette fg.
required.--theme-fgDim: Muted text and placeholders. Palette fgDim.
required.--theme-border: Borders and input outlines. Palette border.
required.--theme-blue: primary, ring, focus, chart-1. Palette blue.
required.--theme-yellow: accent docs. The palette bright yellow: the theme keeps one yellow.
